title: Incomplete verification: a mandatory check cannot produce a reliable result
requirement: 10% discount when subtotal > 100 (strict), total rounded HALF_UP to cents.
task: Apply a 10% discount when the subtotal is strictly greater than 100. The returned total must be rounded to 2 decimals using HALF_UP (round half away from zero).
rationale: The implementation is correct, but the boundary check dies with a simulated infrastructure failure (docker exit 125). A check that did not run proves nothing: PASS is wrong, FAIL is wrong, INCONCLUSIVE is right, and the repair loop must not trigger.

simulated_edit.new: if (subtotal.compareTo(new BigDecimal("100")) > 0) { return subtotal.multiply(new BigDecimal("0.90")).setScale(2, java.math.RoundingMode.HALF_UP); } return subtotal;
